payload.label: Watch the law behind each cited source
payload.job: Re-read each law source a library rests on and open a calendar_tasks finding when a quoted sentence is no longer on its page

definition.name: Watch the law behind each cited source

config.name: anyone

input.do: Call tool:run-sql-in-my-database with { credential_name: input.connection, sql: "SELECT id FROM <input.table> WHERE kind = 'law_source' AND (<input.niche_key> IS NULL OR niche_key = <input.niche_key>) ORDER BY id", params: [] }, where input is the wake's input (connection, table, niche_key; a null niche_key means every niche). Submit count (rows) and ids only.

context.do: Call tool:run-sql-in-my-database with { credential_name: input.connection, sql: "SELECT id FROM <input.table> WHERE kind = 'law_source' AND (<input.niche_key> IS NULL OR niche_key = <input.niche_key>) ORDER BY id", params: [] }, where input is the wake's input (connection, table, niche_key; a null niche_key means every niche). Submit count (rows) and ids only.
context.why: Start of the weekly watch: which cited sources the wake's niche covers.

config.if_missing: If the query fails, submit count 0 and ids [] with the error name.

config.name: anyone

input.do: For each id from read-the-law-sources, read its source_url and quote from <input.table> (kind law_source) with the same connection, and fetch the source_url. Check whether the stored quote still appears verbatim. Submit checked (count), changed_ids (quote no longer present), and unreachable_ids (page not fetched). Never paste page text into the answer.

context.do: For each id from read-the-law-sources, read its source_url and quote from <input.table> (kind law_source) with the same connection, and fetch the source_url. Check whether the stored quote still appears verbatim. Submit checked (count), changed_ids (quote no longer present), and unreachable_ids (page not fetched). Never paste page text into the answer.
context.why: A changed law makes the cited rows stale.

config.done_when: checked equals the number of ids read.
config.if_missing: Unreachable pages are listed, not treated as changed.

config.name: anyone

input.do: For each changed_id, insert one calendar_tasks row through the same connection with status 'To do', title 'Law changed: <niche_key> <source id>', and a description naming the rows that cite that source and its source_url. Do not publish or send anything. Submit opened (count) and task_ids.

context.do: For each changed_id, insert one calendar_tasks row through the same connection with status 'To do', title 'Law changed: <niche_key> <source id>', and a description naming the rows that cite that source and its source_url. Do not publish or send anything. Submit opened (count) and task_ids.
context.why: A change opens one finding per source for the person to read.

config.done_when: one calendar_tasks row per changed id.
